title: gatewatch: merged constitution change without recorded human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit dc8f3c97b301d3c476a8efb88c7acb049fab5393, docs/CONSTITUTION.md lines 1-142 (new file). Article IX requires changes to the constitution to receive explicit human review and not ride an auto-merged PR. The merged commit has no human-review/sign-off marker in its commit message or body; it was merged directly on the default branch. No open gatewatch seed covers this finding.

title: gatewatch: merged audit trigger configuration without recorded human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 32ce2b8d58d1b9ff5a93af59c56c0321f2d71c32, .warren/triggers.yaml lines 1-47 (new audit trigger entries) and .warren/config.yaml lines 1-21. Article IX requires changes to .warren/triggers.yaml audit entries to receive explicit human review and not ride an auto-merged PR. The merged commit has no human-review/sign-off marker in its commit message or body; it was merged directly on the default branch. No open gatewatch seed covers this finding.
